author: Pallas, 1776
summary: 양어장 근처 초지에서 갯지렁이나 곤충을 잡아먹는 할미새이다. 날개 길이는 76~92.5mm, 꼬리 길이는 67~85mm 정도이고, 비번식기 수컷은 이마와 눈썹에만 노란색이 남는다. 러시아 등지에서 번식하고 인도와 동남아시아에서 겨울을 나며, 서남아시아에서는 드문 겨울철새나 나그네새로 관찰된다.

points.en: black from the neck to the shoulders
non-breeding male yellow only on forehead and supercilium

sexes.male: 머리 전체와 아랫면이 진한 노란색이고 목에서 어깨까지 검다. 비번식기에는 이마와 눈썹에만 노란색이 남고 이마 뒤쪽과 뺨이 회갈색으로 엷어지며, 검은 부분도 대부분 사라진다.
sexes.female: 이마 뒤쪽과 뺨이 회갈색이다(비번식기 수컷이 이 점에서 암컷과 비슷해진다).

art.subject: Citrine Wagtail (Motacilla citreola), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on passage in Korea in April and May: whole head and neck bright lemon-yellow; a broad black half-collar across the hindneck reaching down to the shoulders at the sides of the breast; mantle, back and rump plain mid-grey; wings blackish with two broad white wing-bars and white-edged tertials; throat, breast and belly bright yellow, fading to white on the vent and undertail coverts; tail black with white outer feathers; bill black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: walking on grassy ground, picking up insects
art.scene: grassy margins and wet mud beside fish ponds in Korea during spring migration in late April; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view walking: bright yellow head and underparts, black half-collar from the hindneck to the shoulders, grey back and rump, two broad white wing-bars, white undertail coverts, black legs

adult male non-breeding, side view walking: grey crown and ear coverts, yellow forehead and broad yellow supercilium curving round the rear of the ear coverts, underparts much paler with only a pale yellow wash on the throat and breast, black collar mostly gone, grey back, two white wing-bars
art.build: Slender wagtail, 16.5cm, longer than a sparrow mostly because of the long tail; walks briskly on the ground with a horizontal body and wags the tail up and down. Bill thin, straight, black, shorter than the head. Legs fairly long, slim, black. At rest the long tertials almost cover the primaries and the wingtips reach the base of the tail. Tail long, about as long as the body, narrow, black with white edges. Flight undulating, showing the white wing-bars and white tail sides.
avoid: Do not paint an olive-green back or a dark crown with a yellow throat; that is Eastern Yellow Wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis). This species has a grey back and, in breeding males, a yellow head.
Do not paint a black back; the black is only a half-collar on the hindneck, the mantle is grey.
Do not paint yellow undertail coverts; the vent is white.
Do not paint pale or pinkish legs; they are black.
